freeze_states.draft: Preparation record only; no candidate artifact is admissible.
freeze_states.submitted: Public-only package submitted to independent reviewer; no hidden attachment or evaluation is allowed.
freeze_states.accepted: Reviewer recomputed all receipt bindings; candidate admissibility only, never a gate or release result.
freeze_states.invalidated: A binding, signature status, scope, or reproducibility condition is missing, changed, unknown, or rejected.
freeze_states.superseded: A later accepted receipt explicitly replaces an earlier receipt; prior receipt remains immutable.

transition_rules.effect: Hidden attachment, evaluation admissibility, and downstream handoff are blocked; the prior receipt remains immutable evidence.
No artifact is overwritten; the registry records the immutable supersession relation.

canonicalization_and_hashing.canonical_text: Use exactly the artifact-kind rule selected from artifact_kind_mapping_source; no local alternative or partial summary is permitted.
canonicalization_and_hashing.canonical_json: Use exactly the canonical_json_object rule selected from artifact_kind_mapping_source; no local alternative or partial summary is permitted.
hash_workflow: Enumerate declared public-only artifacts deterministically by canonical relative path.
Classify every eligible artifact using nb1-eval-canonical-json-v1 artifact_kind_mapping_source and apply exactly its selected byte rule without altering source evidence.
Create and digest canonical JSON manifest mapping identifiers to digests and sizes.
Bind manifest digest and profile_id in the freeze receipt.
Independent reviewer recomputes the map with the same nb1-eval-canonical-json-v1 artifact-kind mapping source from the accepted public-only bundle.

required_receipt.claim_boundary: Receipt acceptance proves only complete reviewer-recomputed public bundle bindings; it never proves a model claim, independence, hidden-data non-observation, evaluation, gate passage, release, recognition, runtime capability, or external-effect authority.
required_receipt.receipt_signature_policy: No signature is created by this repository task. If an external signature is required by a future accepted process, it must be detached Ed25519, registry-bound, independently verified, and rejected if unknown, expired, revoked, mismatched, self-signed, or invalid.

required_manifests.manifest_policy: Every field, digest, semantic-version, canonicalization profile, source, dependency, model, parameter, protocol, threshold, or generator change invalidates the receipt and requires a new receipt and reviewer acceptance.

versioning_and_supersession.allowed_candidate_version: A declared immutable v4-bound public candidate version only.

registry_and_immutable_storage.storage_requirement: Accepted public-only bundles, manifests, receipts, digest maps, and verification records require immutable or write-once retention with access audit, retention policy, and retrieval integrity verification. This contract configures no storage.
registry_and_immutable_storage.registry_boundary: The repository may define references only. It must not contain a hidden artifact, private key, signing token, real registry entry, or claimed acceptance.

reviewer_verification_steps: Confirm scope is EVAL-01 v4 public-only preparation and v3 is not used.
Confirm clean source tree and complete receipt/manifest fields.
Obtain declared public-only bundle from immutable storage without hidden inputs.
Recompute canonical digests, manifest digests, and bundle digest independently.
Check SemVer, supersession, registry state, dependency lock, generator/specification bindings, and claim boundary.
Record accept, reject, or invalidate outcome externally without altering submitted bytes.
verification_and_handoff.downstream_boundary: An accepted receipt may be presented to a separately governed hidden-attachment review only. It cannot itself attach hidden material or begin, pass, or report EVAL-01.

invalidation_and_rollback.rollback_semantics: Rollback never mutates or deletes a receipt. It records invalidated status and reason, blocks hidden attachment and downstream use, and requires a new complete receipt for replacement.
invalidation_and_rollback.recovery_semantics: Unknown, missing, conflicting, unrecoverable, or partially verified records remain invalidated or not admissible. No inference, retry replacement, or later score repairs the receipt.

preregistered_negative_tests.case: Artifact bytes are tampered after digest computation.
preregistered_negative_tests.expected: Digest mismatch invalidates receipt and blocks handoff.

preregistered_negative_tests.case: Manifest contents or canonicalization profile changes.
preregistered_negative_tests.expected: Manifest drift invalidates receipt; new receipt required.

preregistered_negative_tests.case: Candidate, specification, generator, or receipt SemVer drifts.
preregistered_negative_tests.expected: Version drift is rejected unless a new immutable superseding receipt is accepted.

preregistered_negative_tests.case: Required receipt, model manifest, evaluation manifest, or bundle member is absent.
External process supplies no signature where its accepted policy requires one.
preregistered_negative_tests.expected: Unsigned evidence is rejected; this repository does not create a substitute signature.

preregistered_negative_tests.case: Signature is invalid, unknown, expired, revoked, mismatched, or self-signed.
preregistered_negative_tests.expected: Evidence is rejected and receipt cannot be accepted on that basis.

preregistered_negative_tests.case: Registry record is mutable, absent, or conflicts with submitted receipt.
Hidden material, keys, labels, or raw outcomes enter package or handoff.
preregistered_negative_tests.expected: Custody violation invalidates package and blocks all downstream activity.

external_blockers.description: No actual public-only v4 candidate package or receipt exists.
external_blockers.cause: This preparation task is deliberately contract-only.
external_blockers.required_evidence: Clean committed public-only v4 bundle, immutable receipt, manifests, digest map, and hidden-input exclusion declaration.
external_blockers.impact: Hidden attachment and evaluation remain blocked.
external_blockers.unblocker: Authorize a separate public-only candidate preparation task after prerequisites are met.
external_blockers.follow_on: Independent receipt verification and registry entry.

external_blockers.description: No independent registry, immutable storage, or reviewer identity is established.
external_blockers.cause: Organizational custody and independence cannot be created by repository files.
external_blockers.required_evidence: Role, conflict, custody, immutable-storage, registry, key-status, and revocation attestations.
external_blockers.required_approval: Independent-review authority designation and reviewer acceptance process approval.
external_blockers.impact: No receipt can be accepted or safely handed off.
external_blockers.unblocker: Appoint and externally attest reviewer/registry custody model and immutable retention process.
external_blockers.follow_on: External registry setup and acceptance workflow.

fail_closed: Any unknown, missing, changed, ambiguous, non-canonical, unreproducible, unreviewed, unsigned-when-required, invalidly-signed, revoked, scope-mismatched, custody-violating, or mutable record is not admissible and blocks hidden attachment, evaluation, release, recognition, runtime, and external effects.
